name: Navigate the MDGIFT page and open an FAQ
description: Checks the critical landing page navigation and FAQ interaction.
steps: Scroll to FAQ and open the first question
expected: Initiatives section is reached, the FAQ section loads, and the selected answer expands.

name: Check mobile menu and registration field validation
description: Confirms the mobile navigation works and invalid form details are rejected clearly.
steps: Open the page at mobile width
Open and close the hamburger menu
Submit the contact form with empty fields
expected: The menu opens and closes without overflow, and the form displays validation messages without opening WhatsApp.

name: Prepare a valid enquiry for WhatsApp
description: Verifies valid form details are formatted into a WhatsApp handoff instead of being posted to a backend.
steps: Enter a valid name, email, phone and message
expected: A prepared MDGIFT enquiry is opened through the official WhatsApp number and the form explains that the visitor must review and send the message.

name: Use contact QR and footer navigation
description: Checks the contact options and navigation controls remain available at mobile width.
steps: Scroll to the contact section and inspect the QR code and phone links
expected: The contact links have valid destinations, the footer link scrolls to Initiatives, and back-to-top returns to the page start.
